nodes.description: owner address state variable in Owned; set to msg.sender in constructor and read by the onlyOwner guard.
newOwner address state variable; pending owner for the two-step ownership transfer.
newun address state variable used as a blacklist/transfer-restriction target in transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address => uint) balances holding token balances of every holder.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed holding ERC20 allowances.
_totalSupply uint internal variable set in the constructor to the initial minted supply.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner; stores the pending new owner.
acceptOwnership() public; requires msg.sender == newOwner then finalizes ownership.
transfernewun(address _newun) public onlyOwner; privileged setter for the newun blacklist address.
totalSupply() public view; returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) public view; returns the stored balance.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public; requires to != newun and updates balances.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public; writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public; manipulates newun and moves funds using allowance.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) public view; returns the remaining allowance.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) public; approves and then calls an arbitrary external contract.
clearCNDAO() public onlyOwner; sends the whole contract ETH balance to msg.sender via transfer.
TokenBEP20 fallback function () external payable that always reverts.
PixelInu fallback function () external payable accepting plain Ether.
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance keys and ETH recipient.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed inside approveAndCall with state already written (unsafe external interaction).
Native ETH transfer _owner.transfer(address(this).balance) inside clearCNDAO, pushing funds to msg.sender.
Arithmetic balance/allowance add and sub updates on token amounts in transfer and transferFrom.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter _newun of transfernewun.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Parameter to of transfer.
Parameter tokens of transfer.
Parameter spender of approve.
Parameter tokens of approve.
Parameter from of transferFrom.
Parameter to of transferFrom.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall, used as the external callee address.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall.
Parameter data of approveAndCall forwarded to the external contract.
Local variable _owner in clearCNDAO holding msg.sender as the ETH recipient.

edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner guard on the privileged transfernewun setter depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwner guard on clearCNDAO decides whether the ETH drain runs.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to finalize ownership.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner guard of transferOwnership.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner guard of transfernewun.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner guard of clearCNDAO.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied _newOwner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to verify the pending owner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
transfernewun writes the new blacklist address into newun.
transfer reads newun for the require(to != newun) restriction.
transferFrom reads and can assign newun based on the recipient.
transfer reads balances of sender and recipient.
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom writes updated balances for from and to.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
approve updates allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom reads the allowance of from for msg.sender.
transferFrom subtracts the spent amount from allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall reads/writes allowance for the spender.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply to compute the circulating supply.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], keying state on the caller-controlled address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender both as allowance owner and as the from argument of the callback.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the attacker-controlled spender contract after writing allowance state.
msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument to the external receiveApproval callback.
clearCNDAO pushes the entire contract balance out with a native transfer.
The ETH recipient of the transfer in clearCNDAO is msg.sender.
Local variable _owner holds msg.sender and is the direct receiver of the ETH transfer.
Local variable _owner is assigned from msg.sender inside clearCNDAO.
transfer relies on SafeMath add/sub for token amount arithmetic on balances.
transferFrom relies on SafeMath add/sub for balance and allowance arithmetic.
Parameter _newOwner supplies the value stored into newOwner by transferOwnership.
Parameter _newun supplies the value stored into newun by transfernewun.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes balances in balanceOf.
Parameter to is the credited recipient in transfer and is compared with newun.
Parameter tokens is the amount transferred in transfer.
Parameter spender is the allowance key in approve.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value in approve.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes allowed in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes allowed in allowance.
Parameter spender is used as the allowance key and the external callee address in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is the approved amount in approveAndCall.
Parameter data is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner only exists to be written into newOwner by transferOwnership and carries no independent security role.
Parameter _newun is a plain input whose only use is assigning the newun state variable inside transfernewun.
Parameter tokenOwner is only a mapping key read inside the balanceOf view function.
Parameter to is consumed only by transfer as the credited address and the newun comparison.
Parameter tokens is consumed only by transfer as the transferred amount.
Parameter spender is used only as the allowance key inside approve.
Parameter tokens is used only as the allowance value inside approve.
Parameter from is consumed only by transferFrom for balance and allowance debits.
Parameter to is consumed only by transferFrom as the credited account.
Parameter tokens is consumed only by transferFrom as the moved amount.
Parameter tokenOwner is only a mapping key read inside the allowance view function.
Parameter spender is only a mapping key read inside the allowance view function.
Parameter spender drives the allowance write and becomes the externally called contract address in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is only the approved amount passed through approveAndCall.
Parameter data is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback in approveAndCall.
Local variable _owner simply aliases msg.sender as the direct recipient of the ETH push and has no meaning beyond that transfer.
